hypothesis: Exact-endpoint cubic halfedge traversal can recover bounded atomic faces from admissible contour subsets without moving, deleting or flattening exported curves.
inputs: Accepted P or S cubic chains, native RGB, width and height only; no references, case identifiers or evaluation annotations.
rotation: Outgoing oriented endpoint cubic tangent; fallback to next nonzero control chord. Equal directions within 1e-10 radians are ambiguous and reject their incident chains.
intersection: Adaptive diagnostic flattening <=0.005px, reject detected proper crossings, overlaps, non-endpoint touches and nonsimple chains. This is conservative numerical screening, NOT exact continuous intersection certification.
faces: Directed halfedge next is clockwise predecessor of twin. Keep positive-area simple bounded cycles. Reverse immediate contained child cycles as holes in parent atomic face, while also keeping every child as its own atomic face.
holes: Containment is geometric only; RGB median-border Lab distance<=8 on>=90% sampled atomic interior is a source-background hint, never deletes a face and is not semantic hole truth.
preservation: Output exact original C control points, no synthetic lines, no moved endpoints, no pixel fallback. Rejected/open chains retained as separate unintegrated strokes and explicit audit rows.
semantics: Semantic objects, occlusion, intentional crossing interpretation and complete reconstruction NOT_ESTABLISHED.
export: Corrected svg_exporter.svg_graph with exact chain references and evenodd atomic faces; diagnostic region-ID fills only. Export open/rejected proposal strokes separately.
